title: Intent Engine reference
summary: Commands, flags, environment variables, app configuration and test-file modifiers of @sorsix/intent-engine. Run every command from the consumer workspace; apps default to ./intent-tests/<app>.

sections.title: Commands
sections.intro: intent-engine and intent-test are the same program. Every command needs Node 22.18 or later.

rows.name: run
rows.description: Runs the app's tests in two passes (parallel, then @exclusive with one worker) and reports to the dashboard. Reporting is required.

rows.name: parse
rows.description: Checks test files, seeds and parameter sets without a browser or model. The optional path narrows the check and overrides AT_TESTS.

rows.name: parse-all
rows.description: Runs parse for every app folder in AT_APPS_DIR; fails if any app fails.

rows.name: ids
rows.description: Lists the tests that have no id: line. With --write, adds one under each heading (a slug of the test title, unique across the paths). Reads the files as text, so it works on suites the parser rejects.

rows.name: catalog
rows.description: With an app, prints its suite catalog JSON (profiles, base URL, identity, cases). Without one, lists the apps.

rows.name: develop
rows.description: Develop mode's engine session for Intent Launcher: keeps one browser open and takes newline-delimited JSON requests on stdin (load a case, start, run or verify a step, edit and save, screencast, record), answering on stdout. Starts the app config's webServer when BASE_URL is empty. Needs no dashboard token and does not report.

rows.name: progress
rows.description: Prints run progress every N seconds (default 30) until the run finishes.

rows.name: login
rows.description: Validates a token for the configured dashboard (AT_DASHBOARD_URL or intent-workspace.json) and prints it on stdout. Opens the dashboard to create one unless --no-open is given.

rows.name: publish-suite
rows.description: Uploads the app's suite catalog to the dashboard without running tests.

rows.name: replay
rows.description: Re-uploads a run or suite whose upload is still pending. It does not re-run tests.

rows.name: serve
rows.description: Serves a folder on 127.0.0.1 (PORT, default 4173). A reports folder serves report.html at /.

rows.name: help
rows.description: Prints usage.

rows.name: --version
rows.description: Prints the engine version.

groups.title: run flags
groups.intro: Arguments the engine does not recognise are passed to Playwright for both passes.

rows.name: --app <name>
rows.description: Selects <AT_APPS_DIR>/<name>. Accepted by every app-scoped command.

rows.name: --case-id <id>
rows.description: Runs only these case IDs (the case: prefix is optional; <id>[<row key>] picks one parameter row). Replaces AT_CASE_IDS.

rows.name: --project <phase>
rows.description: Runs only the named pass.

rows.name: --allow-outdated
rows.description: Runs an engine older than the dashboard's minimum version; the run is marked outdated. Same as INTENT_ALLOW_OUTDATED.

rows.name: --purpose <purpose>
rows.default: AT_RUN_PURPOSE → config purpose → the dashboard decides
rows.description: Declares what the run is for. Without it the dashboard records runs by an automation token as verification and every other run as authoring; a declared purpose overrides that. Statistics default to verification runs.

rows.name: --list
rows.description: Lists the tests of each pass. Needs no token and runs nothing.

rows.name: --workers=N
rows.description: Workers for the parallel pass. The exclusive pass always uses one.

rows.name: -g, --headed, --trace on, --grep-invert, --repeat-each, …
rows.description: Passed through to Playwright. Retries are 0 unless --retries is given.

rows.name: --no-open
rows.description: Does not open the dashboard's token page in a browser.

rows.name: --headed
rows.description: Also opens a visible browser window; the screencast keeps working.

rows.name: ?delay=<ms>
rows.description: Query parameter that delays a response by up to 10000 ms.

rows.name: run
rows.codes: 0 all passed and uploaded · 1 a test or pass failed, listing failed or the upload is pending · 130 cancelled (Ctrl-C / SIGTERM)

rows.name: parse, parse-all
rows.codes: 0 valid · 1 a parse error or no app selected

rows.name: ids
rows.codes: 0 every test has an id, or --write added them · 1 ids are missing and --write was not given · 2 invalid arguments or no test files

rows.name: replay
rows.codes: 0 upload complete · 1 still pending or failed

rows.name: publish-suite
rows.codes: 0 uploaded · 1 the upload is pending · non-zero on invalid arguments or authentication

rows.name: develop
rows.codes: 0 after stdin closes, SIGINT or SIGTERM (the browser is closed first) · 1 no app selected · 2 unknown argument

rows.name: Any command
rows.codes: 1 on Node older than 22.18 or an unknown command

sections.title: App selection and scope
sections.intro: Values can come from the shell or from .env files; see Precedence.

rows.name: AT_APPS_DIR
rows.default: ./intent-tests, else the nearest folder with intent-workspace.json
rows.description: Folder that contains the app folders.

rows.name: AT_APP
rows.description: Selects <AT_APPS_DIR>/<name>; set by --app.

rows.name: AT_APP_DIR
rows.description: Uses an app folder anywhere on disk. Wins over AT_APP; the shared .env is then not loaded.

rows.name: AT_ENV
rows.description: Loads <app>/.env.<AT_ENV>. Naming a profile without a file is an error.

rows.name: AT_TESTS
rows.description: Runs one file or subfolder. The whole app is still parsed.

rows.name: AT_CASE_IDS
rows.description: Runs exact durable case IDs. Unknown IDs are a parse error.

rows.name: AT_PARAMS
rows.description: Keeps a subset of every parameter set's rows. Unknown keys are a parse error.

rows.name: AT_INCLUDE_DRAFTS
rows.description: Runs cases tagged @draft too. Without it, run, --list and dashboard discovery leave drafts out; catalog and publish-suite always list them (draft: true).

rows.name: AT_REPORT_DIR
rows.description: Base folder for reports, progress and decision logs.

rows.name: BASE_URL
rows.description: The application under test.

rows.name: IGNORE_HTTPS_ERRORS
rows.description: Accepts self-signed certificates in the browser and in seed requests.

rows.name: PORT
rows.description: Port of the serve command.

sections.title: Browser and timing
sections.intro: Each value falls back to the app configuration, then to the engine default.

rows.name: AT_WORKERS
rows.description: Parallel workers; --workers wins.

rows.name: VIEWPORT
rows.description: Browser size. A value in another format is ignored.

rows.name: TIMEZONE
rows.description: Browser and seed time zone.

rows.name: PW_VIDEO
rows.description: Records a video of every test.

rows.name: AT_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS
rows.description: Time for one whole test.

rows.name: AT_RESOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS
rows.description: How long optional steps and plain expect steps keep looking.

rows.name: AT_REQUIRED_RESOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS
rows.description: How long required steps keep looking.

rows.name: AT_SETTLE_MS
rows.description: Pause after each action.

rows.name: AT_MIN_LOOKS
rows.description: Page looks before a step may fail.

rows.name: AT_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
rows.description: Delay between looks.

rows.name: AT_MAX_REQUEST_CHARS
rows.description: Above this size a model request uses compact page descriptions.

sections.title: Decision model
sections.intro: Pick a preset with AT_DECIDER or the config's decider; override any part with the AT_DECIDER_* variables. API keys only ever come from the environment.

rows.name: AT_DECIDER
rows.description: Decision-model preset. Unknown names are an error.

rows.name: AT_DECIDER_URL
rows.description: Overrides the endpoint. A missing ${VAR} is an error.

rows.name: AT_DECIDER_API_KEY
rows.description: Overrides the API key.

rows.name: AT_DECIDER_MODEL
rows.description: Overrides the model id.

rows.name: AT_DECIDER_MAX_OPTIONS
rows.description: Options per choice question.

rows.name: AT_DECIDER_USD_PER_M_INPUT
rows.description: Price per million input tokens for cost estimates.

rows.name: AT_DECIDER_IMAGES
rows.description: Whether requests include screenshots: always, only after an unsure answer, or never.

rows.name: AT_CHOICE_THRESHOLD
rows.description: Confidence needed to act on an element.

rows.name: AT_YESNO_THRESHOLD
rows.description: Yes probability needed for expect steps and conditions.

rows.name: jev
rows.description: TypeSafe Jev (api.typesafe.ai), model jev-latest. Default.

rows.name: openai
rows.description: OpenAI Decisions API, gpt-6-luna.

rows.name: microsoft
rows.description: Microsoft-Decision-1 on Microsoft Foundry; set MICROSOFT_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT.

rows.name: d3-ultra
rows.description: vllm-sr Decision 3.0 d3-ultra.

rows.name: clef
rows.description: Cloudflare Workers AI, Clef; set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

rows.name: clef-flash
rows.description: Cloudflare Workers AI, Clef-flash; set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

rows.name: llamacpp
rows.description: A local llama.cpp server you started yourself.

rows.name: stub
rows.description: Deterministic offline decider for the engine's self-tests.

rows.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
rows.description: Jev API key.

rows.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
rows.description: OpenAI API key.

rows.name: MICROSOFT_FOUNDRY_KEY
rows.description: Foundry key, sent as the api-key header.

rows.name: MICROSOFT_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT
rows.description: Foundry resource address, e.g. https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com.

rows.name: VLLM_SR_API_KEY
rows.description: vllm-sr API key.

rows.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
rows.description: Cloudflare API token.

rows.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
rows.description: Cloudflare account, filled into the endpoint.

rows.name: AT_LOGIN
rows.description: Logs in through the session steps in the browser instead of the app's API login.

rows.name: AT_ANONYMOUS_FRESH_COOKIES
rows.description: Set to false to keep server cookies between non-login tests and switches.

rows.name: AT_KEEP_SEED
rows.description: Skips seed cleanup, to inspect seeded data.

rows.name: AT_DEBUG
rows.description: Failure messages list every candidate, or the page the model saw for an expect.

rows.name: AT_LOG_DECISIONS
rows.description: Writes model calls to <reports>/decisions/<pid>.jsonl.

rows.name: AT_NET_LOG
rows.description: Appends the app's API calls as JSON lines. May contain personal data.

sections.title: Dashboard reporting
sections.intro: Reporting is optional. With a dashboard URL (AT_DASHBOARD_URL or "dashboard" in intent-workspace.json), run reports there and fails without a token: CI needs an automation token; locally use a personal token from intent-engine login. Runs report into a product that must exist on the dashboard; applications register themselves on their first run. Without a URL, token or product, a run keeps its reports local; a token or product without a URL stops the run.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_URL
rows.description: Dashboard the run reports to, e.g. https://dashboard.example.com. Overrides the workspace file.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_TOKEN
rows.description: Dashboard access token with Upload test results.

rows.name: INTENT_ALLOW_OUTDATED
rows.description: 1, true or yes: same as --allow-outdated.

rows.name: AT_RUN_PURPOSE
rows.description: verification or authoring: same as --purpose; also settable as purpose in intent-tests.config.ts.

rows.name: AT_LAUNCHER_INSTALLATION_ID
rows.description: Set by the Launcher desktop app: its installation UUID, recorded on the run. Not for manual use.

rows.name: AT_RUN_NAME
rows.description: Run display name.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_PRODUCT_KEY
rows.description: Product the run reports into; overrides intent-workspace.json. The product must already exist on the dashboard.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_APP_KEY
rows.description: Application the run belongs to.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_APP_NAME
rows.description: Application display name used when the application is new.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_SUITE_REVISION
rows.description: Label for the suite snapshot; does not change its hash.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_ENVIRONMENT
rows.description: Environment label on the run.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_BRANCH
rows.default: GITHUB_REF_NAME → CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME → current Git branch → local
rows.description: Branch on the run.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_COMMIT_SHA
rows.description: Commit on the run.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_TRIGGERED_BY
rows.default: CI when CI is set, else USER
rows.description: Who started the run.

rows.name: AT_ENVIRONMENT_BUILD_ID
rows.description: Links the run to an Intent Launcher environment version; Launcher sets it.

rows.name: CI
rows.description: When set, an automation token is required and runs are labelled CI.

rows.name: GITHUB_REF_NAME, CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME, GITHUB_SHA, CI_COMMIT_SHA, USER
rows.description: Fallbacks for branch, commit and triggered-by.

sections.title: App configuration
sections.intro: Optional <app>/intent-tests.config.ts exporting default defineConfig({ … }) from @sorsix/intent-engine. Environment variables override these keys.

rows.name: auth
rows.description: How sessions log in: your app's API login (an AuthHook), or the session block's steps in the browser.

rows.name: decider
rows.description: Decision-model preset.

rows.name: presets
rows.description: The app's own decision-model presets, added to the built-in ones (same name: the app's wins). Keys still come from the environment.

rows.name: choiceThreshold
rows.description: Confidence needed to act on an element.

rows.name: yesNoThreshold
rows.description: Yes probability needed for an expect.

rows.name: viewport
rows.description: Browser size.

rows.name: timezone
rows.description: Browser and seed time zone.

rows.name: purpose
rows.description: What the app's runs are for.

rows.name: workers
rows.description: Parallel tests.

rows.name: testTimeoutMs
rows.description: Time per whole test.

rows.name: resolveTimeoutMs
rows.description: Look time for optional steps and plain expect.

rows.name: requiredResolveTimeoutMs
rows.description: Look time for required steps.

rows.name: settleMs
rows.description: Pause after each action.

rows.name: webServer
rows.description: Server started when BASE_URL is empty.

rows.name: intent-workspace.json
rows.description: Committed { "product": "<key>", "dashboard": "<url>" }: the dashboard and product these apps report into (omit both for local-only runs). Put it in the apps folder (e.g. intent-tests/); it also lets the engine run from inside that folder. An app folder may have its own.

rows.name: parameters.ts
rows.description: export const parameters: named sets of rows ({ description?, rows(), key?(row) }). Values are strings, numbers or booleans; row keys are unique, at most 120 characters.

rows.name: seeds.ts
rows.description: export const seeds: named { description?, run(ctx) } returning { vars, cleanup? }. ctx gives baseURL, testId, params, newRequest(), login() and log().

rows.name: .env, .env.<profile>
rows.description: Loaded in order: <AT_APPS_DIR>/.env, <app>/.env, <app>/.env.<AT_ENV>. A value already set is never overwritten.

sections.title: Test-file modifiers
sections.intro: Metadata lines and step modifiers in the Markdown tests. The full grammar is in the engine's docs/test-format.md.

rows.name: id: <id>
rows.description: Durable case ID (letters, digits, . _ -, up to 200 characters), unique in the app.

rows.name: session: <block>
rows.description: Starts the test logged in as that ## Steps: block.

rows.name: seed: <name>
rows.description: Runs the seed first; its values become {{seed.*}}.

rows.name: parameters: <set>
rows.description: Expands the test into one case per parameter row.

rows.name: tags: @a @b
rows.description: Playwright tags (the @ is optional).

rows.name: refs: <ref>, <ref>
rows.description: References to other systems, e.g. TestRail case ids: up to 20, each 1-50 letters, digits or . _ : / -. Listed in the catalog; not part of the case version.

rows.name: @exclusive
rows.description: Runs alone in the second pass.

rows.name: @expect-fail
rows.description: Reported as expected when the test fails.

rows.name: @draft
rows.description: Work in progress: left out of run unless AT_INCLUDE_DRAFTS=true (a draft without steps always); listed in the catalog as a draft. The only test that may have no steps yet.

rows.name: optionally <step>
rows.description: Skips a click, fill, select, check or uncheck when nothing matches.

rows.name: …, only if <condition>
rows.description: Checks a yes/no condition first and skips the optional step if it doesn't hold.

rows.name: expect … within N seconds
rows.description: Keeps checking for up to N seconds.

rows.name: expect <thing> is not shown
rows.description: Checks that something is absent (also is not visible, displayed, listed): asks whether it is shown and passes on a confident no on several looks in a row. Only this single-clause form.

rows.name: select "*" in …
rows.description: Picks the first real option.

rows.name: call … and save "<field>" as "<name>"
rows.description: Saves a response field as {{saved.<name>}}.

rows.name: {{NAME}}
rows.description: An environment variable, filled in when the file is parsed. A missing one is a parse error.

rows.name: {{param.k}}, {{seed.k}}, {{saved.n}}
rows.description: Parameter row value, seed value, saved response value.

groups.title: Which value wins
items: Shell environment, then <AT_APPS_DIR>/.env, then <app>/.env, then <app>/.env.<AT_ENV>: a file never overwrites a value that is already set.
Environment variable, then intent-tests.config.ts, then the preset or engine default.
Workers: --workers, then AT_WORKERS, then config workers, then 2. The exclusive pass always uses one.
App: AT_APP_DIR, then AT_APP (--app sets AT_APP).
Dashboard: AT_DASHBOARD_URL, then "dashboard" in intent-workspace.json; with neither, the run keeps its reports local, unless a token or product is set, which stops it.
Product: AT_DASHBOARD_PRODUCT_KEY, then intent-workspace.json in the app folder, then in the folder containing it; a reporting run without either stops and names the file to create.
Scope: a parse path beats AT_TESTS; --case-id replaces AT_CASE_IDS.
Run purpose: --purpose, then AT_RUN_PURPOSE, then config purpose; without any, the dashboard derives it from the reporter.
Run name: AT_RUN_NAME, then "<App> intent suite".
Login: AT_LOGIN=ui, then config auth, then ui (the session steps in the browser).
Base URL: BASE_URL, then config webServer.url; with neither, the run stops.
Environment version: AT_ENVIRONMENT_BUILD_ID, then discovery from the app.

sections.title: Internal
sections.intro: Set by the engine for its own child processes. Do not set them yourself.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_PHASE
rows.description: Current pass (parallel or exclusive).

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_SPOOL_DIR
rows.description: Upload spool of the running pass; also proves Playwright was started by run.

rows.name: AT_DASHBOARD_DISCOVERY_DIR
rows.description: Where the list pass writes each phase's test plan.

rows.name: TEST_WORKER_INDEX
rows.description: Set by Playwright; warnings print once, in the main process.
